FINDING: Jamelão was the official singer of the samba school Mangueira during the Carnival in Rio de Janeiro.

Jamelão, a Brazilian samba singer known as Jamelão, began his career in music as a tamborim player but later became famous for his role as the official singer at samba school Mangueira's carnival parades. He performed in every Carnaval from 1949 to 2006, making him the longest-serving official singer in the history of the samba school.
